purpose: Realtime discretionary analysis and blind calibration across FX, indices, crypto and metals

newConflictRules: D1 alone cannot force a trade when H4 and H1 oppose it; keep structural bias but downgrade action to WAIT.
M5 or M1 cannot reverse H1/H4 by themselves.
When H4 and H1 are both stretched RSI <= 32 or >= 68 and M5/M1 reverse strongly, directional confidence is capped at LOW-MEDIUM until H1 reconfirms.
A lower-timeframe reclaim is not enough to buy an exhausted metal or crypto trend when H1 remains broken.
If a symbol mapping returns a price scale inconsistent with the intended instrument, classify WRONG_SYMBOL and prohibit analysis/trading.

eventRisk.defaultRule: No fresh MARKET entry immediately before tier-1 data unless the setup is explicitly an event strategy.
eventRisk.metalsAndJPY: Use stricter event veto because response can be nonlinear and fast.

FX.coreRule: Compare currencies first, pair second. Structural D1/H4 bias is preferred; H1/M15 determines whether to enter now or wait.
FX.antiChaseRule: If H4/H1 RSI is stretched and lower timeframes are already reversing, do not chase the structural direction; require H1 reconfirmation.

CRYPTO.executionRule: Use exchange execution price as final MARKET reference and Twelve Data/composite as structure cross-check when available.
CRYPTO.antiCounterTrendRule: A M15/M5 bounce against bearish D1/H4 is tactical only until H1/H4 reclaim.

METALS.exhaustionRule: If D1 RSI > 70, price is at/under major HTF resistance or EMA200, and H1 plus M15 are bearish, prohibit buy-the-dip from M5 alone.
METALS.confirmationRule: For long continuation after a sharp metal selloff, require H1 reclaim/acceptance, not only M5 reclaim.
METALS.eventRule: Tier-1 U.S. data can override technical setup; downgrade to WAIT unless post-event reaction confirms.

INDEX.sourceRule: Exact instrument validation is mandatory. Never treat an ETF/equity sharing an index-like ticker as the cash index.
INDEX.executionRule: Prefer corresponding index future for realtime confirmation; cash index is context, futures are execution/price-discovery reference outside cash hours.

EURUSD.specialRule: D1 bullish with H1 pullback remains BUY-structural only; require H1/M15 reclaim before MARKET.

GBPUSD.specialRule: Structural GBP strength may coexist with H1 bearish pullback; avoid selling solely from H1 when D1/H4 support GBP unless structural break confirms.

USDJPY.specialRule: When D1 and H4/H1 disagree, default NO TRADE. Intervention/event risk is a hard confidence cap.

USDCHF.specialRule: HTF bullish plus deeply oversold M5 is a pullback condition, not an immediate sell; wait lower-timeframe reversal for long.

USDCAD.specialRule: D1 structural trend can dominate a H1 rebound; use rebound rejection rather than chase H1 momentum.

AUDUSD.specialRule: Treat H1 selloff inside D1 uptrend as pullback until H4/D1 structure breaks; require reclaim for long execution.

NZDUSD.specialRule: NEW: when H4 and H1 RSI are near 30 and M5/M1 momentum has already turned up, structural SELL confidence is capped LOW and bias becomes NEUTRAL-TO-SELL until H1 re-breaks. Do not extrapolate an oversold trend.

BTCUSD.specialRule: Bearish D1/H4 plus M15/M5 bounce = sell-rally environment unless H1/H4 reclaim major structure.

ETHUSD.specialRule: NEW: BTC regime weight increased. If BTC D1/H4 is bearish while ETH is below D1 EMA200 and lacks H4 bullish acceptance, classify ETH as BEARISH-NEUTRAL / SELL-RALLIES rather than pure neutral unless ETHBTC relative strength strongly contradicts.

XAUUSD.specialRule: D1 RSI >70 + HTF resistance/EMA200 + H1/M15 bearish = no buy-the-dip from M5. Sell-rally or WAIT until H1 reclaims. Tier-1 U.S. data requires stricter veto.

XAGUSD.specialRule: Use gold framework but require wider volatility allowance and stronger industrial confirmation. No blind calibration evidence on current free feed.

SPX.specialRule: Validate true S&P 500 index/future source; current Twelve Data free feed unavailable.

NAS100.specialRule: Higher duration/rate sensitivity than SPX. Validate true Nasdaq-100/NQ source; current Twelve Data free feed unavailable.

JP225.specialRule: JPY move is a primary driver but correlation is dynamic. Current N225 mapping failed; do not trade until symbol source is validated.

DAX.specialRule: Current Twelve Data ticker DAX returned ~47, inconsistent with intended German index scale; mark WRONG_SYMBOL. Prior apparent PASS is invalid and must not be used as evidence.
